mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_number_sequence (document_type, business_date, last_sequence) VALUES (#{type}, #{date}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE document_type = document_type
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(`${column}`, 3) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM `${table}` WHERE `${column}` REGEXP CONCAT('^', #{prefix}, '[0-9]{3}$')
mapper.update: UPDATE document_number_sequence SET last_sequence = #{sequence} WHERE document_type = #{type} AND business_date = #{date}
